title: Smart controlled-release delivery of Pennisetum purpureum embedded supramolecular nanoparticles to reduce atherosclerotic plaque
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47148-47160
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07519J, Paper

Pennisetum purpureum-loaded supramolecular nanoparticles exhibit green fluorescence, high stability, thermoresponsive controlled release, and selective targeting of inflammatory sites, enabling effective reduction of atherosclerotic plaque.
